description.zh-CN: iOS 开发 preset（受限：签名/模拟器 macOS only）。Linux worker 侧只做代码+文档级验证，构建签名回 macOS 侧——与鸿蒙模拟器降级同构。
description.en-US: iOS preset (limited: signing/simulator macOS only). Linux workers do code+doc-level verification; build/signing returns to the macOS side — isomorphic to the HarmonyOS simulator downgrade.

install.en-US: Swift docs (offline) → shared volume; no Xcode inside Linux containers — boundary is explicit

note.zh-CN: 边界写死不藏着：.ipa 构建/签名必须回 macOS 侧
note.en-US: Boundary is documented, not hidden: .ipa build/signing must return to the macOS side
